statusDetail: Complete atomic audit of public logged-out Facebook templates. Authenticated feed/content, successful credential completion, commerce and account settings were not covered because no test account was supplied.

page.framework: Meta/Facebook server-rendered shell with client-side modules
page.notes: web.facebook.com redirects to www.facebook.com. Audited login, signup, recovery and unavailable-content templates. Excluded authenticated feed/profile/group/video templates because they require credentials.

checkOutcomes.method: Dark/light screenshot comparison plus computed style
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark and light captures are identical; body remains white and color-scheme is normal.
The reduced-motion probe matched the preference and found no active animations on the initial surface.

checkOutcomes.method: prefers-contrast capture plus Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The contrast capture does not adapt and Lighthouse measures the accept control at 4.23:1, below 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Route and invalid-state walkthrough plus stylesheet probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Exercised public links and invalid login update without an observed transition despite stylesheet text mentioning view-transition.
No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, carousel or other scroll-linked motion exists on the audited pre-auth templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, carousel or other scroll-linked motion exists on the audited pre-auth templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Interaction recon across login, signup and recovery
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited pre-auth forms expose no swipe, pull, drag, snapping carousel or other gesture-driven control.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited pre-auth forms expose no swipe, pull, drag, snapping carousel or other gesture-driven control.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The short pre-auth forms have no sticky/affixed scroll chrome or progress surface that needs scroll-state adaptation.
checkOutcomes.reason: The short pre-auth forms have no sticky/affixed scroll chrome or progress surface that needs scroll-state adaptation.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, anchored menu or edge-sensitive popover was present in the audited pre-auth states; cookie consent is modal dialog content.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, anchored menu or edge-sensitive popover was present in the audited pre-auth states; cookie consent is modal dialog content.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Login, recovery and signup expose one prominent primary action and recovery links with clear state copy.
A cookie dialog covers the core task on every audited route before interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM semantics and exercised decline action
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent is exposed as a dialog and its role=button choice can be activated; declining removes the dialog.
After consent, the public surface is a focused form with minimal chrome and compact secondary footer navigation.
Requested 360px viewport becomes a 980px CSS layout scaled to 0.367 because viewport meta is absent.
The login probe detects @container rules, while signup and recovery serve dedicated mobile-width layouts.

checkOutcomes.method: Control geometry and Lighthouse target-size audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary form controls are 38-44px high, major actions are 44px high, and Lighthouse target-size passes.

checkOutcomes.method: First viewport and text hierarchy walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The pages say Log in to Facebook, Get started on Facebook, and Find Your Account, each with one prominent next action.

checkOutcomes.method: Login invalid-state and recovery route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The public authentication flow accepts input, reports invalid identity, links to account recovery, and recovery loads a continuation form; authenticated completion was outside the logged-out scope.

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid login, empty signup and nonexistent-route tests
checkOutcomes.evidence: Errors are visible and actionable, aria-invalid/role=alert is used, and unavailable content offers Feed, Back and Help recovery.
Lighthouse LCP is 6.9s and FCP 5.3s; trace LCP is 2.42s, indicating variable but often poor load performance.
Mobile CLS is 0.0851 and four illustrations omit complete intrinsic dimensions.
Trace found two >130ms tasks and 176.35ms TBT; layout independently saw two >100ms tasks.
Initial delivery is 9.44MB and includes a 7.4MB secondary QR image plus a VeryHigh parser stylesheet.
A basic pre-auth form loads 24 scripts totaling 1.32MB before secondary interactions.
Lighthouse finds an unlabeled consent checkbox; all four cookie illustrations lack alt text.
The Allow all cookies label is 4.23:1 against blue, below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
No semantic headings exist on login, signup or recovery, although main and alert semantics are present.
Form labels, instructions and errors are readable with comfortable line lengths after the intended mobile variants load.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile reflow metrics, target audit and media probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Main route is scaled from 980px at 360px because viewport meta is absent; no video/audio needs captions and target-size audit passes.
An uncaught getElementsByTagName TypeError occurs in scrollToHeader.
Doctype and UTF-8 pass, but four images lack complete dimensions and modern responsive sources.
An unload event listener deprecation is reported; no permission prompt appeared on load.
Final desktop document title is only Facebook and meta description is absent.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM link/viewport probe plus no-JS comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links use href, but viewport meta is absent and raw HTML has only 1% of rendered words.
Canonical targets en-gb while final host is www; robots is valid, but /sitemap.xml responds with HTML rather than XML.
The generic login/account-gateway page is not an article, product, event, place or other rich entity requiring schema.org/share metadata.
checkOutcomes.reason: The generic login/account-gateway page is not an article, product, event, place or other rich entity requiring schema.org/share metadata.

checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, nosniff and DENY framing are present; no cookies or client-side secrets were found before consent.
No known trackers or pre-consent cookies were observed; network origins are Facebook/Meta-controlled, with one Instagram identity request.

checkOutcomes.method: Load behaviour and authentication attribute probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt appeared on load; username uses autocomplete="username webauthn", showing passkey-capable conditional auth support.
Strong HSTS, clickjacking and Permissions-Policy controls are present, but Referrer-Policy is absent and style-src allows unsafe-inline.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML/rendered DOM diff and crawler screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML retains only 1% of rendered words and crawler view is effectively blank.

checkOutcomes.method: Consent dismissal, invalid state and route navigation walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dialog dismissal, validation state, recovery navigation and unavailable-content controls remained stable without cut-off on exercised routes.
The audited gateway is for an intrinsically networked authenticated social service; no manifest or controlling service worker exists, and offline sign-in is not a meaningful task.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited gateway is for an intrinsically networked authenticated social service; no manifest or controlling service worker exists, and offline sign-in is not a meaningful task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Unavailable content explains the state and offers Go to Feed, Go back and Visit Help Centre.
Document declares lang=en and dir=ltr, rendered CSS contains logical properties, and multiple explicit language choices are offered.
The audited pre-auth templates render no dates, numbers, currencies, durations or calendars requiring locale formatting.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited pre-auth templates render no dates, numbers, currencies, durations or calendars requiring locale formatting.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited pre-auth templates contain no event times, time-zone data or DST-sensitive scheduling.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited pre-auth templates contain no event times, time-zone data or DST-sensitive scheduling.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Decline optional cookies is explicit without confirmshaming, signup commitments link to Terms/Privacy/Cookies, and account recovery is easy to find.

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid login and empty signup submission
checkOutcomes.evidence: Errors appear after submission, use aria-invalid and role=alert, and give concrete corrective text.
Signup sets autocomplete=off on all core fields and login password has no current-password token.
Signup states account creation terms and data use before Submit, login offers recovery, and username webauthn indicates phishing-resistant auth support; no commercial flow appears pre-auth.
A secondary QR JPG transfers 7.4MB; four PNG illustrations lack responsive sources and modern formats.
Only three xhr/fetch requests were seen, no autoplay media exists, and no known tracker was detected pre-consent.
The login surface transfers 9.44MB, dominated by 7.4MB QR media plus 1.32MB scripts and 183KB font.
Facebook explicitly disallows major AI agent crawlers including ClaudeBot, GPTBot and PerplexityBot, indicating this public gateway is intentionally not agent-facing.
checkOutcomes.reason: Facebook explicitly disallows major AI agent crawlers including ClaudeBot, GPTBot and PerplexityBot, indicating this public gateway is intentionally not agent-facing.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The login/signup/recovery tasks have no appropriate summarisation or language-model need; absence of on-device inference is not a quality gap here.
checkOutcomes.reason: The login/signup/recovery tasks have no appropriate summarisation or language-model need; absence of on-device inference is not a quality gap here.

checkOutcomes.method: Interaction inventory and attempted heap exercise
checkOutcomes.evidence: No safe representative repeatable interaction exists on the pre-auth page without account state; separate-session heap captures cannot establish retained-growth causality.
checkOutcomes.reason: No safe representative repeatable interaction exists on the pre-auth page without account state; separate-session heap captures cannot establish retained-growth causality.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline snapshot totals 43.6MB self size and runtime reports 20.7MB JS used for 685 live DOM nodes, proportionate though not minimal.
Neither heap summary surfaces Detached* constructors among the dominant populations; no evidence of unbounded detached DOM/listeners was found in this bounded pre-auth state.

principleOutcomes.reason: Facebook explicitly blocks major AI crawlers and the audited authentication gateway has no intended agent-facing capability.

paths.description: Logged-out landing and login archetype; inspected initial consent, post-consent DOM, invalid credentials, desktop/mobile and preference conditions.
Account creation form archetype; inspected field semantics, autocomplete and empty-submit validation.
Account-recovery archetype; inspected recovery copy, form and route continuity.
Unavailable-content/error archetype; verified recovery actions on an intentionally nonexistent URL.

findings.summary: Logged-out Facebook ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The light and dark captures are byte-identical (75,968 bytes), and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal with a white body under dark emulation.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and retint surfaces and controls with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Public route and state changes are abrupt.
findings.evidence: The route/state probe found stylesheet View Transition text, but exercised navigation uses ordinary full-page links and the invalid-login state swaps without an observed transition.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply same-document View Transitions to validation/state changes and cross-document transitions to compatible public routes, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Cookie consent obscures the entire primary task on first load.
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360px screenshots show a modal overlay hiding login, signup, recovery and error content until a cookie choice is made.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep legally required consent concise and content-first, preserve equally prominent choices, and avoid the long educational card stack in the blocking first-load layer.

findings.summary: The main logged-out route omits the viewport meta tag and renders as a scaled 980px desktop canvas on mobile.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport, layout reports innerWidth 980, scale 0.3673 and hasViewportMeta false; the screenshot shows tiny page content.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to this variant and use intrinsic, fluid sizing without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: Mobile loading is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 6.9s, FCP 5.3s and Speed Index 7.8s (performance 0.60); the independent trace reports LCP 2.42s, showing material run variance but still late paint.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP element, remove the oversized QR asset from initial delivery, and defer noncritical scripts and styles.

findings.summary: Cookie illustrations do not reserve complete dimensions and shift the mobile layout.
findings.evidence: Images reports all four cookie PNGs missing a height attribute; mobile layout observed CLS 0.0851 with a shift at about 2.4s.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height or aspect-ratio on every illustration and preserve its slot before loading.

findings.summary: A hidden/secondary QR illustration dominates initial transfer.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 9,444,146 transferred bytes; QrCodeLoginPizza.jpg alone transfers 7,395,126 bytes and takes 1.68s.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch the QR artwork until the QR-login affordance is opened; resize and encode it in an efficient modern format.

findings.summary: The simple logged-out form ships a disproportionate script payload.
findings.evidence: HAR records 24 scripts and 1.32MB of script transfer for the login/consent surface, with 32 redirect-host requests treated as third-party by the capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split the logged-out route, conditionally load QR/consent detail modules, and audit coverage for unused bundles.

findings.summary: Startup includes avoidable long main-thread tasks.
findings.evidence: The trace records two long tasks (142.77ms and 133.58ms) and 176.35ms total blocking time; layout independently observed 101ms and 135ms tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Break startup work into schedulable tasks and defer noncritical hydration and consent-detail code.

findings.summary: The consent and image content contains missing accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports an unlabeled cookie preference checkbox; images reports all four cookie illustrations without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every functional form control an explicit accessible name and provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for genuinely decorative images.

findings.summary: The primary cookie acceptance label misses WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measures white text on #1877f2 at 4.23:1 where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the blue surface or adjust text styling until the control reaches at least 4.5:1 in every preference state.

findings.summary: Public authentication pages have no semantic headings.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found zero h1-h6 elements on login, signup and recovery despite visible page-title text; the login page relies on a div with role=main.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real h1 for each page purpose, preserve the main landmark, and verify keyboard focus order and focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: The main login variant fails mobile reflow because it lacks a viewport declaration.
findings.evidence: The 360px capture is rendered at 980 CSS pixels and scaled to 36.7%; the page probe confirms no viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an accessible viewport declaration and reflow the form at narrow widths without maximum-scale restrictions.

findings.summary: Facebook logs an uncaught exception during audit load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading getElementsByTagName) in scrollToHeader.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard the missing node path and add regression coverage for the logged-out mobile route.

findings.summary: Image markup is incomplete and contributes to layout shift.
findings.evidence: The image audit found four of four PNG illustrations without complete width/height dimensions and all use legacy PNG without srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources, and efficient formats for cookie illustrations.

findings.summary: The page registers deprecated unload listeners.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports one deprecation warning for unload event listeners in D4XXlyqmJxr.js, which can also harm BFCache eligibility.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide or visibilitychange and verify BFCache restoration.

findings.summary: The desktop logged-out document has generic metadata.
findings.evidence: The direct DOM probe reports title “Facebook” and no meta description; this does not describe the login surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a route-specific descriptive title and concise meta description for public logged-out pages.

findings.summary: Crawler/mobile signals differ across variants, and the desktop route lacks viewport metadata.
findings.evidence: The direct logged-out DOM has real href links but no viewport meta; discoverability reports only 1% raw/rendered word coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the core login purpose and links in HTML consistently and include the viewport meta on every variant.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The document canonical points to en-gb.facebook.com while the audited final URL is www.facebook.com; /sitemap.xml returns a 295KB HTML page rather than sitemap XML.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a valid sitemap or a clear 404, and align canonical/hreflang signals with the locale variant served.

findings.summary: The otherwise strong header set omits Referrer-Policy and permits inline styles.
findings.evidence: Headers confirms HSTS, CSP, nosniff, DENY framing and Permissions-Policy, but Referrer-Policy is absent and style-src contains unsafe-inline.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter Referrer-Policy and migrate inline styles toward nonce/hash-backed policy where feasible.

findings.summary: The core logged-out content is almost absent without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability fetched 377,678 bytes of raw HTML but found only 8 text characters and 1% content-word coverage; crawler screenshot is effectively blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the login purpose, form labels and recovery/signup links, then progressively enhance interactions.

findings.summary: Signup disables autofill and the login password lacks a suitable autocomplete token.
findings.evidence: Signup probe reports autocomplete="off" for name, contact and password fields; login uses username webauthn for identity but no password autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Use name/given-name/family-name, email or tel, new-password for signup, and current-password for login while retaining webauthn on the username field.

findings.summary: A 7.4MB image is delivered for a secondary QR-login affordance.
findings.evidence: HAR identifies QrCodeLoginPizza.jpg as 7,395,126 transferred bytes, 78% of the 9.44MB page load.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate an appropriately sized AVIF/WebP asset and lazy-load it only when the QR flow is requested.

findings.summary: Initial transfer is disproportionate to a basic login form.
findings.evidence: HAR records 9.44MB across 41 requests, including a 7.4MB image, 1.32MB scripts and 183KB font before the secondary QR flow is opened.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a logged-out page-weight budget, defer secondary media and scripts, and monitor first-load bytes in CI.

taskList.title: Fix the mobile viewport and reflow on the main logged-out route
Remove the 7.4MB QR image from initial delivery and set a logged-out page-weight budget
Server-render the core login content and metadata for no-JS resilience and discovery
Repair consent accessibility: labels, alt text, contrast and headings
Restore standards-based autocomplete across login and signup
Reduce startup script/main-thread work and remove unload/console failures
Reserve image dimensions and modernise cookie illustration delivery
Add user-preference theming and calm state transitions
Shorten the blocking cookie-consent first layer
